adaptation: Domain types and validation are implemented locally from the portable-dataset contract. No original private state, native store, source client or current-state projection code is copied into this repository.
privateInput: Fixed authenticated A13 selector preserved-portable-dataset; exact private bytes remain outside source control.
scope: Owner-global archived namespace academy.sites.academy-rails-current.student, distinct from native PostgreSQL StudentBinding; archived ownerId is preserved import-label metadata only.
preservation: Original array order and every saved record remain accessible; explicit supersedes/retracts/conflicts are not applied as current state.
Source-event correction fields retain exact values and unknown semantics; no correction expands into whole-record invalidation.
Raw JSON, source clocks, provenance verification/completeness/pagination and source archive paths remain inert claims.
Original artifact IDs and filenames survive; download requires unique owner-global A13 SHA/byte/MIME equality plus a fresh exact-byte read; this verifies byte custody only.
Native opaque student keys and archived names/IDs/source namespaces are never joined.
acceptance: Local source and synthetic browser verification only; real native custody, currentness, complete source roster, factual student identity and human teacher acceptance remain separate unqualified gates.
